title: Open the Alchemy Laboratory
description: The Tower has a chamber intended for alchemy, but shelves and stonework do not make a laboratory. Demonstrate working command of Ars Elixirum's own pharmacological system. Once its persisted mastery recognizes your first level of practical competence, the Tower's Alchemy facility can be treated as operational; deeper mastery belongs to the Alchemy questline itself.
description_completed: The Dark Tower's Alchemy Laboratory is operational. Further Ars Elixirum mastery remains part of the dedicated alchemy-pharmacology progression.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign
